covers: JSE morning session to 10:59 SAST on Friday 13 November 2026; US items are from Thursday's close
headline: JSE extends losses in morning trade as Naspers and Prosus fall over 2%; rand weakens to R16.87/$ and gold slips below $3,900
summary: By 10:59 SAST the JSE All Share was at 112,343.82 and the Top 40 at 104,403.85, both about 0.5% below Thursday's close, with Naspers down 2.1% and Prosus down 2.4% (LRC Market Dashboard and LRC Stock Scanner (Yahoo Finance), 13 Nov 2026 to 10:59 SAST). The rand was at R16.87/$, weaker than R16.75 early this morning and 2.3% weaker than a week ago, after Thursday's jump in US bond yields to 5.10% on the 10-year (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 12-13 Nov 2026). Gold was at $3,899.10, below Thursday's $3,920.60 settle and 4.3% lower on the week, platinum fell 2.0% to $1,507.70 and Brent rose 1.0% to $96.46, so gold shares and rand-sensitive stocks remain under pressure ahead of US producer prices this afternoon (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 6-13 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia closes 4.3% lower after CEO Jensen Huang resigns
items.summary: Nvidia ended Thursday at $166.19, down 4.3% from Wednesday's $173.70 close, trimming a deeper intraday fall. Colette Kress is interim CEO. CNBC's live coverage reports President Trump calling the episode a 'horrible thing'. Results are still scheduled for 17 November.
items.source: CNBC and MarketWatch headlines, 12-13 Nov 2026 (to 04:32 SAST); LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance NVDA), 11-12 Nov 2026 closes

items.title: US bond yields post their biggest surge since 2022 on Fed rate-hike fears
items.summary: MarketWatch reports the sharpest jump in Treasury yields since 2022 as markets price more Fed rate hikes. The US 10-year yield closed at 5.10%, up from 4.86% a week earlier.
items.source: MarketWatch headline, 13 Nov 2026 00:16 SAST; LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^TNX), 12 Nov 2026 close and 6 Nov 2026 close

items.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close 0.4% lower; futures rise overnight
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,592.40 (-0.4%) and the Nasdaq at 25,366.09 (-0.4%), giving up an early recovery in the final hour. CNBC reports stock futures rising early on Friday.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ^GSPC, ^IXIC), 11-12 Nov 2026 closes; MarketWatch headline, 12 Nov 2026 22:25 SAST; CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 04:29 SAST

items.summary: AMD closed at $585.30 and Broadcom at $364.36, while Applied Materials fell to $380.95.

items.title: Cisco beats and says AI infrastructure revenue will double this year
items.summary: Cisco reported after the close; CNBC reports an earnings beat and a forecast that AI infrastructure revenue will double in fiscal 2027. The shares had closed 1.2% higher at $102.01 before the release.
items.source: CNBC headline, 12 Nov 2026 23:20 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 close (CSCO)

items.title: Cerebras jumps after hours on a revenue beat and a Microsoft deal
items.summary: CNBC reports Cerebras up 17% after hours after beating on quarterly revenue and announcing a deal with Microsoft. The shares had closed 3.3% lower at $97.75.
items.source: CNBC headline, 13 Nov 2026 04:43 SAST; LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), 12 Nov 2026 close (CBRS)

items.title: JSE about 0.5% lower in morning trade; Naspers -2.1%, Prosus -2.4%
items.summary: The All Share was at 112,343.82 (Thursday close 112,894.87) and the Top 40 at 104,403.85 (Thursday 104,981.31) at 10:59 SAST. Naspers was 2.1% lower and Prosus 2.4% lower at 10:44 SAST as tech stocks stayed weak after Nvidia's slide. Gold miners also fell: AngloGold Ashanti -1.7%, Gold Fields -1.2%, Harmony -0.9%.

items.title: SPAR 1.7% lower after the Phil Roux appointment falls apart
items.summary: SPAR shares were 1.7% lower at 10:37 SAST on Friday, after News24 reported overnight that the appointment of Phil Roux had fallen apart (covered in this morning's brief).
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance SPP.JO), 13 Nov 2026 10:37 SAST; News24 headline, 13 Nov 2026 03:45 SAST

items.title: Rand weakens to R16.87/$; R18.65/€, R22.29/£
items.summary: USD/ZAR was at 16.87 at 10:59 SAST, from 16.75 early this morning and 16.48 a week ago (2.3% weaker). The euro was at R18.65 and the pound at R22.29. A stronger dollar and higher US yields are the main pressure; SA CPI (18 Nov) and the SARB decision (19 Nov) are next week.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance ZAR=X, EURZAR=X, GBPZAR=X), 13 Nov 2026 10:59 SAST and 6 Nov 2026
